title: My profile
subtitle: This is what other members see, and what you can change about it.
completenessHint: Add a photo, your city and a couple of skills to rank higher in matches.
emailLocked: Your email is your login and can't be changed.

visibility.title: Visibility
visibility.description: Decide who can find you and what they can see.
visibility.peopleHint: Members can find and browse your profile in the directory.
visibility.peopleHiddenHint: You are hidden from the directory and from anyone who is not already a friend.
visibility.bondsHint: Your active and past bonds are listed on your public profile.
visibility.bondsHiddenHint: Your bonds stay private; visitors only see your name and reputation.
visibility.hiddenNote: These settings apply to the direct link as well: hidden profiles show a locked notice instead of your data.

detail.aboutEmpty: No description yet. Tell people what you can offer and what you are looking for.
detail.skillsEmpty: No skills added yet. Skills are what matching looks at.

bonds.hiddenNote: Only you can see these bonds right now.
bonds.emptyDescription: Create your first exchange and start building reputation.

reviews.empty: No reviews yet — they appear after a completed bond.

form.photoHint: Square image, at least 400×400 px. JPG, PNG or WebP.
form.name: Name
form.bioPlaceholder: What you give, what you need, and how you like to work
form.bioModerated: Descriptions are reviewed automatically before they go live.
form.skillsHint: Up to {max} skills. They are what matching looks at.
form.linksHint: Portfolio, shop or social page. Up to {max}.

password.title: Password
password.description: Use at least 6 characters. Changing it signs out your other sessions.
password.sessionsHint: Every other device is logged out. Your profile and bond history stay untouched.
password.savedDescription: Other sessions now need the new password.

danger.title: Delete account
danger.description: Your profile, bonds and reputation are removed. This cannot be undone from the app.
danger.consequence1: Bonds still open with other members are left without you.
danger.consequence2: Your reviews and rating disappear with the account.
danger.consequence3: You can register the same email again later, but the history will not come back.
danger.confirmDescription: Type DELETE and your password to confirm.
danger.mockDescription: This is a mock flow; the real deletion comes with the API wiring.

settings.title: Settings
settings.subtitle: Everything you can change about your account.
